full_prompt_en: The image is a flat, hand-drawn fantasy townscape beneath an enormous turquoise fish, set against a dark blue-green sky with a small orange sun at the upper left. The fish fills most of the upper half and faces left, its broad body extending toward the right edge. A large concentric eye near the head forms a prominent circular focal point, with rings of yellow, orange, teal and dark blue nested around a black center. The fish’s body is built from layered geometric scales, fins and stripes in turquoise, mint, navy and pale cream, each shape bounded by dark outlines. Below it, a compact town rises along both sides of a winding blue-green waterway. Small houses cluster in uneven rows, their roofs forming triangles, steps and rounded caps; pale yellow, coral and mint walls alternate with narrow dark windows. The channel curves through the lower middle, widening toward the front and leading the eye beneath the fish. Stylized trees and upright plants punctuate gaps between the buildings, their foliage reduced to simple red, green and teal shapes. At the upper-left corner, a small orange sun with concentric circular marks hangs above the roofline, bright against the cool sky. The background remains graphic and shallow, with no realistic atmospheric distance; overlapping forms and changes in size create the compact depth. Even, unmodeled color fills preserve a printed, cut-paper quality, while slight variations in contour keep the geometry from feeling mechanical. The lighting is symbolic rather than naturalistic: the sun adds a warm accent, but the fish, houses and water remain evenly colored without cast shadows. An arched bridge crosses the channel on the left, while stairs and block-like buildings rise on the right. A small pale sailing boat with a thin mast and dark red hull rests on the lower-left water. Fine hatching, dotted patterns and horizontal water marks add a printed texture within the flat shapes. The composition sets the fish’s large curved mass above the small town, and the bending waterway links the two scales. Its playful, surreal mood comes from this deliberate mismatch of monumental animal and miniature settlement, unified by crisp shapes and a vivid cool palette.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅平涂手绘的幻想城镇景观，一条巨大的青绿色鱼悬于其上，背景是深蓝绿色天空，左上角挂着一枚橙色小太阳。鱼占据上半部大部分空间，头朝左，宽大的身体向右侧延伸。靠近头部的一只巨大同心圆眼睛成为醒目焦点，黄色、橙色、青绿色和深蓝色圆环层层套叠，围住黑色中心。鱼身由层叠几何鱼鳞、鱼鳍与条纹组成，色彩包括青绿、薄荷绿、海军蓝和浅奶油色，每个形状都有深色边线。下方，一座紧凑小城沿弯曲的蓝绿色水道两岸向上铺开。小房屋以不规则行列聚集，屋顶呈三角形、阶梯形和圆弧形；浅黄、珊瑚红与薄荷绿墙面交替，点缀窄小深色窗户。水道穿过下方中央并逐渐弯曲，向近景处变宽，引导视线从鱼身下方穿行。风格化树木和直立植物填入房屋间隙，叶簇被归纳为红、绿与青绿色的简洁形块。左上角的小橙日带有同心圆标记，悬在屋顶线上方，在冷色天空中格外明亮。背景保持图形化且空间浅，没有写实的空气透视；形体叠压和大小变化构成紧凑纵深。均匀、未作体积塑造的色块保留印刷剪纸般的质感，轮廓略有变化，避免几何形显得机械。光线具有象征性而非写实性：太阳带来暖色点缀，鱼、房屋和水道仍以均匀色面呈现，没有投影。左侧一座拱桥跨过水道，右侧有阶梯和块状建筑向上叠起。左下水面上停着一只浅色小帆船，细桅杆立在深红船身上。细排线、点状纹样和水平水纹在平涂形状内部增加印刷质感。构图将大幅弯曲的鱼身置于小城上方，弯曲水道连接起两种尺度。巨大动物与微型聚落的刻意反差带来俏皮奇幻感，并由清晰形状和鲜明冷色统一起来。
style_prompt_en: The style combines flat geometric drawing, dark outlines and vivid blocks of turquoise, teal, coral, yellow and navy. Large forms are reduced to layered simple shapes, while concentric circles and repeated stripes create focal rhythm and surface pattern. Color remains even and matte, with warm accents set against cool expanses so the eye moves between them. Curves and angled edges weave through compact arrangements, and shifts in scale make the space feel shallow yet lively. Forms share a consistent simplified vocabulary with fine printed hatching and dotted textures rather than realistic modeled shading. Dark contours separate adjacent colors, while small open areas prevent dense patterns from merging. The result is graphic, playful and surreal, with its energy carried by shape, color contrast and the relation between large and small forms.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格结合平涂几何绘制、深色轮廓和鲜明的青绿、蓝绿、珊瑚红、黄色与海军蓝色块。大型形体被简化为层叠图形，同心圆与重复条纹则形成焦点节奏和表面纹样。色彩保持均匀哑光，暖色点缀与大面积冷色并置，引导视线在其间移动。弧线和斜边穿行于紧凑布局中，尺度变化令空间显得浅而活泼。各种形体共用一致的简化词汇，以细印刷排线和点纹增添质感，不依赖写实体积阴影。深色轮廓分隔相邻色块，少量空隙避免密集图案彼此融合。整体效果图形化、俏皮而超现实，活力来自形状、色彩反差以及大小形体之间的关系。
theme_en: A giant left-facing turquoise fish with a concentric eye above a compact town and winding waterway
theme_zh: 同心圆大眼的青绿色巨鱼朝左，悬于紧凑小城与蜿蜒水道上方
name: Andy Rementer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
